title: ‘The Invite,’ ‘Late Fame,’ and Many More Movies Lead SFFILM Festival Lineup
description: This year's San Francisco International Film Festival will open with Olivia Wilde and Kent Jones' respective films and close with a Star Wars Day special screening of "The Empire Strikes Back."
